case_name: Shitala Sharan Nigam vs State Of U.P.And Another
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent got married. Dispute arose, leading to cases filed by respondent against petitioner. Compromise was entered into on 11.11.2009. Despite compromise, petitioner is being harassed by police.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise agreement can be a binding settlement.
legal_principles.held: It is understood that the cases filed by the respondent no. 2 against the petitioner shall stand withdrawn.

legal_principles.principle: A party to a compromise agreement must honour its terms.
legal_principles.held: However, despite the compromise the petitioner is being harassed by the police in pursuance of the cases lodged by the respondent no. 2 against the petitioner prior to the filing of the application.

outcome.final_order: Further proceedings in pending cases stayed till next date of listing.
